answer: Resist sybils by bonding each agent identity to a slowly vesting willow of non-transferable stake that only matures after a long meadow of attested epoch work. Fresh sockpuppets start with zero maturity and earn nothing until they climb that vesting curve; mass cloning therefore multiplies locked capital without unlocking yield. At the zenith of the curve, reputation and payout concentrate on long-lived identities, so the expected cost of an attack exceeds its return.
